name: Frontier Model Watch
description: Tracks first-party announcements from ten labs — xAI, Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Moonshot, Alibaba, Zhipu, MiniMax and Tencent — and files a single digest each morning at 07:30 East Africa Time. Suits people who want release news from the source; it will not cover rumours, leaks or third-party commentary.
